assertions.text: Stage10 S10-13 CE-selection should be stated narrowly: among LoopCert-style contenders (LoopCert-only, family-balanced blend, risk-calibrated blend, and Pareto-front), all four improve macro_normalized_regret_at3 versus CFC-only, but none improve mean_cost_to_contain_winner versus CFC-only; therefore ce_selection_gate_passed is false and the formal gate verdict remains closed. OrbitRepair-Proxy beats both metrics in SELECTOR_METRICS.csv, but is treated here as a proxy/baseline row rather than a LoopCert-style contender.

summary: Repaired the analysis-profile evidence gap using read-only Stage10 S10-13 selector metrics.
